deviations.source_anchor: Minor drift: HotG's identity is a SETUP-GATED single nuke -- its full damage REQUIRES a fully-broken-armor + heavy-stunned target, a cross-skill prerequisite chain (Armour Breaker + Earthshatter + warcries -> then Hammer). The engine maps the pieces (ground_slam + sunder + stun + a GEOMETRY_COLLAPSE door) but expresses the 'HotG deals MORE into broken armor' coupling as a generic burst rather than a first-class conditional-damage gate; the player keeps the slow-wind-up-into-massive-slam feel and the break-then-hammer sequence, but the precise 'broken-armor multiplier' is door/trait-level. The colossal-slam core maps cleanly -> CLOSE.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: GX-03 (corpus gx). HOT-FLAG 8 RESOLVED: HotG -> ground_slam (phrase-book 'slam/quake -> ground_slam'; a falling overhead hammer-slam IS the ground_slam member, the from-above delivery is the slam's arc, distinct from a projectile-rain which would be ground_targeted_circle). Armor-break setup -> sunder (main-law exposure: HIT-PROC armor-break window -> sunder, NOT curse:sap -- it's an on-hit shred, not an aura/hex; and the Armour Breaker swing itself -> melee_arc). stun kept for HotG (fetched loop: 'wait to land a Heavy Stun with Earthshatter, then... dropping the Hammer' -- stun is a load-bearing prerequisite). Physical -> element-neutral throughout (physical rule; elem_raw=physical). chain_count=3 per R-M2 (>=3 load-bearing actives: HotG + Armour Breaker + Earthshatter stun-setup; corpus core_skills lists HotG+Armour Breaker+Perfect Strike). GEOMETRY_COLLAPSE routes the conc single-huge-hit identity; SACRIFICE_ASCENDANCY routes the Titan all-in-on-one-hit tradeoff (slowest attack, highest impact). Titan ascendancy -> t4 via 5 (R-M1). D2 Leap-Attack-barb correlate (corpus mech_note) noted. eras 0.1-0.3 CONFIRMED.
mapping_json.motion_frame: Set up the kill: pre-stack Earthshatter spikes, land a Heavy Stun, break armor (Armour Breaker + Seismic/Infernal Cry), THEN drop the colossal Hammer of the Gods on the stunned, armor-broken target for the biggest single hit in the toolkit.
